runs.title: Find a hotel
runs.goal: Use the destination search and filters to find Design stays in Lisbon with Free cancellation, then open Casa Flora.

runs.title: Open a research article
runs.goal: Open the reading-room article titled Confidence is not correctness.

runs.title: Search and filter a catalog
runs.goal: Search the catalog for headphones, choose the Audio category, enable In stock only, sort by Price: low to high, then open Studio Lite headphones.

runs.title: Submit a synthetic support request
runs.goal: Submit a demo support request for Alex Chen at alex.chen@example.com. Choose Billing, enter the message I was charged twice, enable Send a copy, and stop when the receipt appears.

runs.title: Navigate and scroll a guide
runs.goal: Open the Structured output guide, find the Retry policy section farther down the article, and expand its implementation example.

runs.title: Select an asynchronous suggestion
runs.goal: Find Kyoto using the city search, select Kyoto, Japan from the suggestions, and open its city guide.

runs.title: Find a Wikipedia article
runs.goal: Find and open the Wikipedia article about Gödel’s incompleteness theorems.

runs.title: Search future flights
runs.goal: Find one-way flights from Zurich to London on February 01, 2027, for one adult in economy. Stop when matching flight options are visible. Do not select or book a flight.

measurement.elapsed_ms: Agent decision loop; excludes browser setup and independent final verification
measurement.wall_ms: Browser setup, decision loop, independent verification and cleanup
measurement.scope: Live attempts on named tasks; synthetic fixtures are not a general web benchmark
measurement.replay: Executed actions and separate decision scores; no recorded video or simulated actions

original_8000_service.scope: One replay of the exact largest recorded request after the timed batch; the complete browser suite was not rerun on this service.

evidence_notes: One complete run of each of eight named scenarios on one browser profile; not a general reliability benchmark.
Every decision was scored by JevStyle and reviewed by the recorded local 27B model; probabilities remain JevStyle scores.
Original failures, interrupted r13 and its corrected-verifier recheck are separate evidence and were not relabelled.
Images are actual discrete browser snapshots, not continuous video.
